title: Irrelevant Alternatives Bias Large Language Model Hiring Decisions

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the change in selection probability of a target candidate when an asymmetrically dominated decoy candidate is added to the choice set in a hiring scenario.
Varying the gender of the candidates (target, competitor, decoy) using possessive pronouns to examine its influence on the magnitude of the attraction effect.
Evaluating the target choice probabilities across all permutations of candidate presentation orders to measure the impact of option order and identifiers.
